core_obligations: Testing: show the sheafy trace map induces a bijection Hom_Y(M, Rf_*RSheafHom(L, Rf^!K)) -> Hom_Y(M, RSheafHom(Rf_!L, K)) for every M in D(Y_etale, Lambda) (proof lines 4159-4165).

String of equalities: expand to Hom_X(f^{-1}M, RSheafHom(L, Rf^!K)), then Hom_X(f^{-1}M tensor L, Rf^!K), then Hom_Y(Rf_!(f^{-1}M tensor L), K) by construction of Rf^!, then Hom_Y(M tensor Rf_!L, K) by the projection formula (the important step), then Hom_Y(M, RSheafHom(Rf_!L, K)) (proof lines 4166-4179).
Anchors: first equality by the adjunction lemma, second and fifth by the internal-Hom adjunction lemma, third by construction of Rf^!, fourth by the projection formula lemma (proof lines 4180-4188).
